case.component: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM: INTEGRATED TRAILER BRAKE CONTROL
case.narrative: The contact owns a 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500. The contact stated that the trailer brake control module failed to operate as needed while hauling a trailer, causing the trailer to lose braking capability. The vehicle was taken to a local dealer where it was diagnosed, and the contact was advised that the trailer control module was faulty and needed to be replaced. The vehicle was repaired; however, the failure persisted. The manufacturer was notified of the failure. The approximate failure mileage was 63,500.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
